On each trial, participants read a statement introducing a person using a gradable adjective of one of four adjective types: positives (e.g., happy, tall), antonyms (e.g., short, unhappy), and their respective negations (not X). Antonyms were one of two types: morphological (e.g., unhappy) and lexical (e.g., short). Participants rated the character on a scale from "the most positive person" to "the most antonym person" (item-dependent) using a slider bar (Fig. 4A). Participants rated one sentence at a time and saw items from both antonym types throughout the experiment. Each participant completed a total of 16 trials, with exactly 2 repetitions of each adjective type for each antonym type.

issues.title: Exp 1 instruction text not printed
issues.reason: The paper does not print the instructions shown to participants.
issues.impact: A replay must supply framing text; wording differences could shift ratings.
issues.suggestedAction: Supply the original instructions from the authors' materials, or accept a minimal neutral framing recorded as a replay adaptation.

issues.title: Exp 1 sentence frame and names not printed
issues.reason: Only Expt. 2 gives an example sentence ("Greg is not unhappy"); no frame or character names are listed for Expt. 1.
issues.impact: Stimulus sentences must be constructed; names and frame may affect ratings.
issues.suggestedAction: Supply the original sentences, or accept the 'NAME is (not) ADJECTIVE' frame from the Expt. 2 example as a replay adaptation.

issues.title: Exp 1 slider numeric range not stated
issues.reason: Slider range and start position are not stated, and how 'positive' and 'antonym' in the endpoint labels are filled in per item is not shown in text (Fig. 4A).
issues.impact: Raw ratings are on an unknown numeric scale; effect sizes (b) are not comparable.
issues.suggestedAction: Supply the original slider range and endpoint wording, or accept a documented 0-100 range with the item's own adjective words in the endpoint labels as a replay adaptation.

issues.title: Exp 1 trial order and item sampling not stated
issues.reason: The order of the 16 trials and which 8 of 10 adjective sets per antonym type each participant sees are not stated.
issues.impact: Item sampling and order must be chosen for the replay.
issues.suggestedAction: Supply the original randomization, or accept random sampling without replacement per participant as a replay adaptation.

issues.title: Exp 1 demographics not reported
issues.reason: Age, gender and other participant characteristics are not reported.
issues.impact: AI participant personas cannot be matched to the human sample.
issues.suggestedAction: Record that no persona is specified; do not invent demographics.

issues.title: Exp 1 completion count not separately reported
issues.reason: n completed is not given separately.
issues.impact: Randomized, completed and analysed counts cannot be distinguished.
issues.suggestedAction: Treat 120 as recruited and 114 as analysed.

issues.title: Exp 1 normalization formula garbled
issues.reason: The normalization formula is garbled in the PDF text layer.
issues.impact: The normalized plots in Fig. 5A may not be reproduced exactly.
issues.suggestedAction: Check the formula on the page image; the text suggests rating minus participant mean, divided by participant SD.

issues.title: Exp 1 means shown only in a figure
issues.reason: Mean normalized ratings are plotted in Fig. 5A but not tabulated.
issues.impact: Cell means cannot be compared numerically with a simulation.
issues.suggestedAction: Obtain cell means from the authors' data, or compare orderings only.

issues.title: Exp 1 significance criterion not stated
issues.reason: The alpha level is not stated.
issues.impact: Minor: the reported p-values are given.
issues.suggestedAction: Use the reported p-values; assume the conventional .05 only if the researcher confirms.

issues.title: Native-language exclusion cannot apply to AI participants
issues.reason: Exclusion for self-reported non-English native language relies on a question not printed in the paper.
issues.impact: Replay applies no exclusion; analysed N equals simulated N.
issues.suggestedAction: Record as a replay adaptation.

issues.title: Exp 2 instruction text not printed
issues.reason: Instruction text is not printed.
issues.impact: Replay must supply framing text.
issues.suggestedAction: Supply original instructions, or accept minimal neutral framing as a recorded replay adaptation.

issues.title: Exp 2 sentence frame and names not printed
issues.reason: Only one example sentence ("Greg is not unhappy") is given.
issues.impact: Frame and names for 240 statements must be constructed.
issues.suggestedAction: Supply original sentences, or accept 'NAME is (not) ADJECTIVE' with neutral names as a replay adaptation.

issues.title: Multiple-utterance display not described in text
issues.reason: Layout, names and order of the four simultaneous statements are only in Fig. 4B; also whether '12 trials' means 12 ratings in 3 displays of four is not explicit.
issues.impact: Display structure for the multiple-utterance arms must be assumed.
issues.suggestedAction: Check Fig. 4B; the replay assumes 3 displays of four statements (12 ratings), each display from one adjective set.

issues.title: Exp 2 slider numeric range not stated
issues.reason: Slider range and start position are not stated.
issues.impact: Raw ratings are on an unknown scale.
issues.suggestedAction: Supply the original range, or accept a documented 0-100 range as a replay adaptation.

issues.title: Exp 2 trial order and item sampling not stated
issues.reason: The order of trials/displays and which of the 20 adjective sets each participant sees are not stated.
issues.impact: Item sampling and order must be chosen for the replay.
issues.suggestedAction: Supply original randomization, or accept random sampling without replacement per participant.

issues.title: Exp 2 assignment to conditions not described
issues.reason: Counts per condition are given but not how participants were assigned.
issues.impact: Replay runs the stated number per arm.
issues.suggestedAction: Run the stated n per arm.

issues.title: Exp 2 demographics not reported
issues.reason: Demographics are not reported.
issues.impact: AI persona cannot be matched.
issues.suggestedAction: Do not invent demographics.

issues.title: Exp 2 completion count not separately reported
issues.reason: n completed is not given.
issues.impact: Counts cannot be distinguished.
issues.suggestedAction: Treat 750 as recruited and 715 as analysed.

issues.title: Exp 2 normalization not restated
issues.reason: Normalization for Fig. 5B is not restated; assumed as Expt. 1.
issues.impact: Plotted means may differ.
issues.suggestedAction: Check against the authors' scripts.
